closed_findings.finding: Unexpected verifier finding codes could carry provider prose into metadata.
closed_findings.resolution: Only approved codes and fixed semantic problem codes are emitted.

closed_findings.finding: Malformed completion metadata discarded returned output.
closed_findings.resolution: Bounded raw output stays private with original hash, byte count and truncation flag.

closed_findings.finding: HTTP loopback exception could forward operator session credentials.
closed_findings.resolution: Production calls require HTTPS; explicitly labeled synthetic transports exist only in test invocation.

closed_findings.finding: Usage warnings concealed missing authenticated coverage.
closed_findings.resolution: Incomplete coverage takes precedence, while individual warning status remains visible.

closed_findings.finding: Native pre-header failures could claim observed response evidence.
closed_findings.resolution: Observed evidence also requires an actual HTTP status.
